items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice again Thursday; consecutive DNPs after Week 4 injury. Rapoport notes Barkley week-to-week and not expected for London Week 5 vs JAX; Tank Bigsby (abdomen/core) on IR after surgery.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs on hamstring; week-to-week per Rapoport, Bigsby IR.
items.implication: Eagles RB room collapses to Will Shipley as primary; start Shipley if available, fade Barkley/Smith.
items.opportunity: Full backfield and receiving snaps/routes for Shipley and remaining WRs/TEs; goal-line/third-down to Shipley.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson did not practice Thursday due to ankle. Friday practice looms large for Sunday Night availability vs ATL; door left open but status uncertain.
items.why: Ankle injury, consecutive DNPs; Friday key indicator.
items.implication: Monitor Friday closely; if OUT, Huntley starts and Ravens pass game/Receivers downgraded, RBs mixed.
items.opportunity: If OUT: backup QB upside limited; Flowers/Likely/Andrews volume stable but efficiency down.

items.text: ETR/Levitan: With Barkley and Bigsby OUT, 'it's gonna be the Will Shipley show against Jacksonville.' Waiver elevating Shipley as primary Eagles RB option.
items.why: Both primary RBs sidelined; Shipley sole healthy roster RB.
items.implication: Shipley becomes must-add/start RB2/flex vs soft JAX run D aspects; handcuff value inverted.
items.opportunity: High snap share, carries, routes, red-zone with Eagles OL and Hurts.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Monitor; if OUT, Shakir/Coleman/Kincaid volume up in BUF pass game.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey no practice again Thursday (foot/ribs context); second straight DNP ahead of vs DEN.
items.implication: High risk of limited/OUT; QJ/Johnston/Hampton usage upside if sits.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets shift to other Chargers WRs/TE if inactive.

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift practiced limited Thursday (knee/hip); Kyle Monangai DNP second straight (thumb/toe) ahead of vs GB.
items.implication: Swift likely plays but monitored; if limited snaps, other CHI RBs/WRs benefit.
items.opportunity: Snap share protection if Monangai out; watch Friday.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase returns to practice Thursday, meaningful step toward clearing concussion protocol (suffered Sunday).
items.implication: Optimistic for Sunday vs MIA; if clears, full WR1; else Higgins/Gesicki/Meyers surge.
items.opportunity: If OUT: high route/target share to Tee Higgins, Gesicki (end-zone), Meyers.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. re-injured foot (plantar fasciitis); HC McCarthy says expected to miss multiple weeks.
items.implication: Pittman sit multi weeks; Roman Wilson/DK Metcalf/Pickens? wait Steelers WRs elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets/routes for remaining PIT WRs (Metcalf, etc.).

items.text: Levitan xFP: Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams overperforming opportunities; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown under. Week 5 projs live, DET-ARZ popular high-total stack. Injury variance list includes Barkley/Smith/Lamar/Chase etc as top ADP misses.
items.why: Sortable xFP data shows over/under on opportunities; slate context for stacks.
items.implication: Trust Bijan/Kyren efficiency; fade or lower Jeanty/Brown until regression; stack DET-ARZ.
items.opportunity: Continued high opportunity share for overperformers.
items.conflict: Berry loves Chase Brown despite under xFP.

items.text: Berry loves Nico Collins as WR8 vs TEN; volume/red-zone hog in favorable matchup.
items.why: Target volume and matchup vs Titans secondary.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown as RB5 @ MIA; workload and Bengals injuries boosting role plus soft run D.
items.why: Volume + matchup + CIN pass injuries spillover.
items.conflict: Levitan notes Chase Brown underperforming xFP opportunities so far.

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson WR10 vs DET, Christian Watson WR15 vs CHI, Isaiah Likely TE5 @ WSH for volume/matchup reasons.
items.why: Target hogs and defensive weaknesses flagged.

items.text: Berry loves Jaylen Warren RB12 if Rico Dowdle remains OUT, and Aaron Jones RB8 @ NO for workload and soft run defenses.
items.why: If Dowdle out, Warren volume; Jones free post-Mason IR, Saints soft.

items.text: ETR Man vs Machine: Sean Payton taking back playcalling from OC Davis Webb (confirmed Rapoport); discuss Eagles tank chatter, Bengals WR injuries, DET-ARZ viability.
items.implication: Potential Broncos offense/scheme shift boosting Nix/Sutton/Harvey efficiency or volume.
items.opportunity: Monitor early-down/pass rate changes for DEN skill players.
